newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyon-Satolas airport freight up 9.8pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Lyon-Satolas airport freight up 9.8pct in 1996.

text.p: 1996 airfreight handled at Lyon-Satolas airport totalled 21,509 tonnes, up 9.8 percent on the same period in 1995, airport authority figures show.
Air cargo traffic on international routes accounted for 12,968 tonnes, up 10.7 percent on 1995.
In 1996, the number of full-freighter flights operating at Lyon totalled 5,829, up 32.7 percent on the previous year
Airfreight tonnage transported on full-freighter aircraft totalled 9,735 tonnes, down 5.3 percent on 1995.
Postal traffic handled at Lyon-Satolas totalled 13,542 tonnes, up 5.2 percent on the same period of last year. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
